Package com.example.allot.controller

Class EventController

java.lang.Object
com.example.allot.controller.EventController
public class EventController extends Object
Handles event-related Firestore operations, including creating events, joining and leaving waiting lists, retrieving events, and filtering browsable or registered event lists.
